q: How does a dye intermediate unit in Vatva count CO2 from its boiler and thermic fluid heater?
title: Vatva dye unit boiler and heater CO2
short: Add up every fuel burnt: coal, briquettes, natural gas or furnace oil in the boiler and thermic fluid heater. Multiply each by its calorific value and factor. Steam bought from a common facility is not your Scope 1, but its emissions are a cost your buyer may ask about.
audience: Dye and chemical units in Vatva and nearby Ahmedabad estates

ul: Grid electricity for reactors, filters and dryers.
Process emissions, if any reaction releases CO2.

p: Fuel invoices, stock registers and gas bills, matched to production batches.
Divide by kilograms produced, or allocate by batch steam use when several products share the boiler.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
